integrity: The attached standard-library verifier constructs all 16 Picard classes, all 1920 Weyl actions, and checked unimodular Smith certificates; an independently implemented SymPy computation corroborates the values.
scientific_limitations: Classifies coinvariants conditional on the actual Frobenius Weyl type, not fieldwise realization of all 18 abstract types. Not Picard, Brauer, or graph-critical-group torsion. Older unindexed adjacency-module tables remain a residual priority risk.
title: Integral Frobenius coinvariants of the sixteen-line intersection map on degree-four del Pezzo surfaces
